issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Animal subclasses (Seal, Pig, Goat): the template's example code in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java uses two-argument constructor calls (commented lines like new Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the problem statement/UML and the reference solution define animals with a single attribute (name) and implement single-argument constructors (e.g., Seal(String name), Pig(String name), Goat(String name)). This inconsistency can mislead students to implement extra attributes or additional constructors not specified by the UML, or cause confusion when following the provided example code.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the example usage in the template with the UML/problem statement and solution by updating the commented constructor calls in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use single-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle"), new Pig("Doodle"), new Goat("Buttinsky")). Alternatively, if an additional attribute was intended, update the UML and problem statement to include that attribute and modify the reference solution and template consistently so all artifacts use the same constructor signature.
